name: PolicyItem
description: Represents an item within a ServerPolicy object that contains the settings for one policy.
remarks: A policy item cannot exist outside the scope of a policy. Policy items are distinct conditions defined for a document stored on a server running Microsoft Office SharePoint Server.
example:
Sub ListPolicyItems()
Dim objSrvPolicy As ServerPolicy
Dim objPolicyItem As PolicyItem
Dim strPolicyItemList As String

Set objSrvPolicy = ActiveDocument.ServerPolicy

For Each objPolicyItem In objSrvPolicy
 strPolicyItemList = "Policy Item " & objPolicyItem.Name & " - " & _
 objPolicyItem.Description & vbCrLf
Next
MsgBox (strPolicyItemList)

End Sub

properties.name: Application
properties.description: Gets an Application object that represents the container application for the PolicyItem object. Read-only.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Gets a 32-bit integer that indicates the application in which the PolicyItem object was created. Read-only.

properties.name: Id
properties.description: Gets the ID of a policy item. PolicyItem objects are contained in ServerPolicy objects. Read-only.

properties.name: Name
properties.description: Gets the name of the PolicyItem object. Read-only.

properties.name: Description
properties.description: Gets a description of the current state of the policy item. Read-only.

properties.name: Data
properties.description: Gets the information that is used to implement the policy item. Read-only.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Gets the Parent object for the PolicyItem object. Read-only.
